verdict.rationale: doola documents a dashboard with digital access to received physical mail through its Registered Agent service. It also documents per-company compliance tracking: a compliance calendar plus annual-report filing, and partner-side retrieval of formation documents. However, nothing shows a single account consolidating multiple entities and their state registrations, or shared multi-user team access. The Partner Portal evidence covers only API key management by signed-in users, not team seats on an operating account. missing for 10: evidence of multi-entity management in one account, team/multi-user access with roles, a consolidated view of state registrations across entities, independent or hands-on corroboration.
